Enemies may appear where you least suspect...|[[Narrator (Narrator)|Narrator]] dialogue on Wave 7 ([[Trick or Threat Town]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Buried''' was an enemy that appeared exclusively in [[Trick or Threat Town]] as part of the [[Halloween 2020 Event]]. The '''Buried''' had average speed and about average health for the time it appeared. However, the main threat was its ability to bury underground. Once it lost at least half of its health (at 62 health or lower), it would bury itself into the ground and moved along the path underground. It would then pop out later on down the path, passing many of your towers. ==Appearance== The '''Buried''' had teal green skin, with its torso and legs colored brown. Its rib and right leg were cut open and exposed. Bone could be seen in these cuts. It also had a shocked face. Its head was slightly tilted downwards. ==Strategy== *When '''Buried''' reaches half of its health or lower, it buries itself underground, making itself untargetable by most towers. **They can still be damaged by an explosion, though another targetable enemy must be present on the surface. **It can be targeted by [[Accelerator]] while it is underground (or in the process of sinking underground), so long the [[Accelerator]] was locked onto it as it began to sink underground. ***While it is underground, the [[Accelerator]] cannot detect it. **The [[Electroshocker]] can still hit the '''Buried''' while it is underground via a chain reaction. **Fire damage from the [[Pyromancer]] and bee damage from the [[Swarmer]] can inflict damage on the '''Buried''' while it is underground, so long the effects were applied before the '''Buried''' went underground. *When it emerges, the '''Buried''' will be immobilized for half second and can be attacked. *[[Military Base]]s will pass over this enemy when it is buried, but [[units]] can still collide with the '''Buried''' a second before it emerges or buries. **This tower is recommended against the '''Buried''' as they will emerge later on down the path. *You can spread your defenses around the map to ensure no '''Buried''' reaches the end of the map. **Making '''Burieds''' go underground sooner is effective as they will arise from underground sooner. This allows your towers to have a higher chance of killing them before they reach the end. *If a '''Buried''' is instantly killed (or damage dealt exceeds the remaining health left, and the '''Buried''' is still overground), the '''Buried''' does not sink underground. **Therefore, for this reason, Level 3+ [[Ranger]]s are very effective against '''Burieds'''. ==Trivia== *When '''Buried''' buried itself, it would walk very slowly under the path. **It was possible to see the '''Buried's''' health (and where it was) if you put your cursor on the path to where it was. **You were able to see '''Buried''' when it was buried, when it crossed under the bridge in [[Trick or Threat Town]]. The animation of the '''Buried''' underground was the same walk animation it used above the ground. *The shocked face on the '''Buried''' is based on the ﾟдﾟ emoticon, popularized from 2channel. ==Update History== *'''31 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.1|Overhaul v1.1.0]] **'''Buried''' added. *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **'''Buried''' removed. {{TrickTown|[[Ghost (Trick or Threat Town)|Ghost]]|Wave 6|Buried|Wave 7|[[Reanimated]]|Wave 9}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
